records.title: VITA-1.5: Towards GPT-4o Level Real-Time Vision and Speech Interaction
records.reason: The architecture addresses the latency overhead of separate ASR/TTS components, so it is plausibly related to multimodal serving; however, the paper does not quantify comparative latency or isolate an inference optimization. Retain as borderline pending a reproducible end-to-end latency benchmark.

records.title: PlainMamba: Improving Non-Hierarchical Mamba in Visual Recognition
records.reason: The primary abstract scopes the work to visual recognition; no language-model or serving result is reported.

records.title: SOFT: Softmax-free Transformer with Linear Complexity
records.reason: This is a plausible transferable attention design, but the source does not test language modeling, causal attention, or LLM serving. Retain as borderline pending a decoder-only long-context benchmark and quality comparison.

records.title: RoboMIND: Benchmark on Multi-embodiment Intelligence Normative Data for Robot Manipulation
records.reason: The abstract describes collected trajectories and task coverage, with no model runtime or serving method.

records.title: Pan-Mamba: Effective pan-sharpening with State Space Model
records.reason: Its state-space design is evaluated on multi-spectral image reconstruction; no LLM inference claim is present.
